text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You wanna see some magic?
Well, all right then! I'm in a good mood, so just this once!"

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you!
I'm so excited, so excited...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Acacia, cassia, sansevieria!
May our friendship be forever undye-ing...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mm, ahem! Vocal warmups are all set!
Now it's time for the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh, what's that supposed to mean?!
I can say it! I can totally cast a spell, you knowww!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, no matter how many times she tried, Sweep Tosho kept stumbling over her words and ended up throwing a tantrum.
